buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DG Set shall be installed at below location: 1. 30 Hrs Package S NO LOCATION OFFICE ADDRESS 1 LIC of India, RAMBAN Main Market RAMBAN 2 LIC of India, Kishtwar Main Market Kishtwar 3 LIC of India, LEH Main market LEH For Technical Evaluation Bidders are requested to submit following documents: 1) Chartered Accountant Certified Proof of Annual Turnover for FY 2023-22024, 2024-25 and 2 025-2026 in support of condition of minimum average annual turnover mentioned in the bid docu ment which states that “the minimum average annual turnover of the bidder should be ₹ 10 Lakh . 2) Copies of Work order/ experience certificate executed in FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-202 6 in support of condition specified in Bid Document for Years of Past Experience which states as " The bidder must have experience for number of years as indicated above in bid data sheet (ending mo nth of March prior to the bid opening) of providing similar type of services to any Central / State G ovt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company” 3) Copies of Work orders/ experience certificate executed in FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-20 26 in support of condition specified in Bid Condition for Past Experience of Similar Services which states as "The Bidder must have successfully executed / completed at least one single order of 80 % of t he Estimated Bid Value i.e 25.60 lakhs or 2 orders each of 50 % of the Estimated Bid Value i.e. 16.00 lakhs or 3 orders each of 40 % of the Estimated Bid Value i .e 12.80 lakhs for similar service (s) in last three years to any Central / State Govt organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Estimated Bid value is ₹ 3200000

4) Signed Copy of Buyer Organization Specific Integrity Pact, specimen uploaded in the Bid Spec ific terms and conditions, specimen uploaded in point 2 of Buyer added bid specific terms and co nditions. 5) Satisfactory Performance Certificate from minimum 2 Clients (Different Organizations VIZ Centr al / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company) issued for the works executed for the l ast 5 Financial Years including current financial year. 6) A Declaration shall be uploaded by the vendor “the Bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt and is not blacklisted by any Ce ntral / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company”. 7) "Annexure I" (ESG) to be included as part of tender document, specimen uploaded in Buyer uploaded A TC Document. The declaration submitted shall be signed and dated after Bid publish date. In Addition to the Service Level Agreement of GeM, Contract shall also be governed by the following terms and conditions. 1) Please note that D.G. Set of repute makes viz. Cummins India / Kirloskar Green / Greaves / Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. / Ashok Leyland / Tata Motors/ Eicher Engines TMTL only are accepted. DG Set shall be suitable to generate Single phase, 230 volts, 50 Hz at 1500 rpm complet e in all respects with acoustic enclosure conforming to the norms of pollution control board. The ap proval of make of Engine, Alternator & Enclosure must be obtained well before procurement. If at any stage it is found that DG set provided is not of approved make, LIC reserves the right to order the contractor to remove the DG set & provide new DG set as per approved makes. 2) Extra Running of DG Set beyond the package limit of 30/hrs per month will be paid on pro rata basis as per GeM SLA for this service. 3) Operator Waiting Charges for the duty beyond the duty hours shall be paid as ₹ 100/ hour, furt her No Extra Operator charges for Saturdays during the duty hours, shall be paid. 4) The successful bidder has to install New DG set at the location and has to submit copies of purc hase invoice after purchase of new D.G. set. The name, address & phone no. of service centre shal l also be mentioned.

5) Test Certificates for Diesel Generator set: The copies of the following tests performed by the manufacturer prior to packing & dispatch to sit e are to be submitted to LIC of India, Srinagar Division within 15 days from the date of installation :- a. Load test at full load 50% load, 75% and 110% overload. b. Fuel consumption at full load, 75% load, 50% load and 25% load. c. Other routine test as per IS / BS on alternator, exciter and AVR. d. Noise level measurement. e. DG set must comply with Central Pollution Control Board norms as per Environmental Protection rules (1986) 6) The arrangements for providing accessories like new cables, new change-over switches, and fre sh earth stations will be made by the contractor at their own cost. If the mentioned items are not p rovided by the vendor, Corporation shall arrange at the risk & cost of the vendor and same shall b e recovered from the monthly hiring charges of the vendor. 7) Electric Duty, if any payable to the State Govt. depending on running hours of the DG Set shall b e borne by the contractor. Installation of Energy meter with its calibration and registration with th e Statutory Authority shall be done by the contractor at their own cost. 8) The Contract shall remain inforce initially for a period of three years from the date of installatio n and satisfactory commissioning of the DG Set at Site which may be renewed for further period of t wo years at the accepted rates / charges and keeping other terms & conditions unchanged, depen ding upon the satisfactory services rendered by the generator supplier and requirement of the offi ce . 9) Price Adjustment for the cost of running of DG Set due to variation in price of Diesel shall be do ne on basis of fuel consumption of diesel for operation of DG in a given period as per below menti oned calculation: Basic Diesel Price (at the time of tenderi Rs. R Per Litre ng)

Average Monthly price of Diesel in the bi Rs R1 Per Litre lling month Fuel Consumption per hour for price adj L Litre per hour ustment Price Variation on fuel Charges (Diesel C N X L X (R1-R) ost) Price Variation on fuel Charges (Diesel Cost) N - Consider average hr. operation of DG Set in a month L- 1.75 Litre per hour for Fuel Consumption during office hours Basic Diesel Price at the time of Tender is ₹ 92.81 per litre Successful Vendor has to claim variations, if any with their monthly bills. 10) Successful Vendor has to obtain Insurance Policies to cover Fire, Third Party Liability and Work men Compensation Insurance of suitable amount for each policy immediately after the installation of New DG set at the location which shall remain in force till the contract period and extension if granted and to submit the copies of all the insurance policies within 15 days from date of installa tion. Penalty @ Rs 500 per day from the date of installation of DG set shall be levied upon the ve ndor for the delayed period. In case of renewal of insurance policy, Payment shall be withheld if the Insurance Policies Laps e and penalty @ ₹ 200 per day for such lapse period shall be recovered from the bill raised by th e contractor. If the Policies are not renewed within 30 days of expiry, corporation may get the insu rance policies renewed and Premium Amounts along with the penalty of ₹ 25000 shall be recov ered from the vendor. The contractor shall be wholly responsible for any mishap during such lapse period and damage recoveries if any shall be made from the payment to the contractor. 11) In the event of breakdown of DG Set due to unavailability of fuel or whatsoever reason on the part of vendor a penalty of 5% of monthly rent per hour shall be levied on the contractor. This pen al clause overrides the penalty clause mentioned in GEM SLA. 12) Unauthorized supply of power to other agencies / firms from the DG Set installed at our premis es if an y are found, action will be taken against the vendor as deemed fit by the competent autho rity.

13) The Contract is subject to termination at any time if the services are not found satisfactory by LIC or for any other reason whatsoever by serving 30 days’ notice in writing by LIC and 90 days’ n otice by the agency. 14) The contractor will have to remove the DG Set from the LIC Premises within 07 (Seven) days fr om the date of termination or closure of the contract at their cost, else demurrage charges @ ₹ 10 00/day will be levied by the LIC of India, on the contractor. 15) A Log Book shall be maintained for recording daily running of DG Set which should be signed b y the D G Set operator and verified by the authorized official of LIC of India. 16) LIC of India shall not be responsible for any injury partial or permanent or death of any worker at site due to accident or by personal negligence of the staff of the contractor. LIC of India will rem ain indemnified by the contractor on this account. 17) Contractor shall be responsible for payment of wages / salaries and allowances to his personn el that might become applicable under any government order. LIC of India shall have no liability w hatsoever in any manner. 18) In terms of provisions of Section 33 (3) of the Insurance Act, 1938 as amended by the Insuranc e Laws (Amendments) ordinance, 2014. Insurance Regulatory Authority of India (IRDAI) is authoriz ed to verify all such books of account, register, other documents and data base in the custody of t he contractor in respect of service outsourced by the LIC of India. It shall be the duty of the contra ctor to provide such documents / statements / information / as may be required by IRDAI within su ch time as may be specified by the IRDAI. 19) Any dispute arising out of the Contract/Agreement shall come under the jurisdiction of the Hon ourable Courts in Jammu only . . 3. LIC OF INDIA payable at JAMMU . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. DD should be made in favour of LIC OF INDIA payable at JAMMU . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7.
